news.title: Zelensky asks Putin to meet face-to-face, with US ‘fully focused’ on Iran
news.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Thursday shared a letter asking Russian President Vladimir Putin for a face-to-face meeting while the U.S. remains “fully focused” on Iran.
